experiments: Eight single-purpose deterministic experiments, one per claim class (C1/C2 analytic baselines, C4a/C4b discriminating power at task-matched capacity, C4c capacity boundary, C5 threshold scale-dependence, C6 gradient-health semantics, C3 live documentation inspection). Pure-python stdlib only; fixed seeds; no workspace writes.

cases.name: C1 analytic baselines: chance CE = ln(K), confident CE -> 0
cases.objective: validate every baseline number the record quotes (ln2=0.693147, ln10=2.302585, near-one-hot CE approaching 0)
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import math, sys

ok = True
# C1a: chance-level CE = -log(1/K) = ln(K) for K=2 and K=10
for K in (2, 10):
    chance = -math.log(1.0 / K)
    expect = math.log(K)
    match = abs(chance - expect) < 1e-12
    ok = ok and match
    print(f"C1 K={K} chance-CE={chance:.6f} ln(K)={expect:.6f} exact-match={match}")

# C1b: CE of a near-one-hot confident correct prediction approaches 0
p_correct = 1.0 - 1e-9
ce_conf = -math.log(p_correct)
print(f"C1 near-one-hot CE={ce_conf:.9f}")
ok = ok and ce_conf < 1e-6

# C1c: constant p=1/K prediction on the true class = ln(K)
K = 10
ce_const = -math.log(1.0 / K)
print(f"C1 constant-predictor CE on true class={ce_const:.6f}")
ok = ok and abs(ce_const - math.log(K)) < 1e-12

# reference constants quoted in the knowledge record
print(f"C1 ln2={math.log(2):.6f} ln10={math.log(10):.6f}")
ok = ok and abs(math.log(2) - 0.693147) < 1e-5 and abs(math.log(10) - 2.302585) < 1e-5

print("C1-BASELINES-VERIFIED" if ok else "C1-BASELINES-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

expected.failureCriteria: any baseline mismatch or missing marker

cases.name: C2 class-spanning requirement: single-class batch voids the test
cases.objective: show a constant predictor scores 100% on a single-class batch but exactly 1/K on a class-spanning batch
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys

ok = True
# A constant predictor always outputs class c.
# Single-class batch (all labels = c): it scores 100% with zero learning.
# Class-spanning balanced batch: it scores exactly 1/K.
for K, c in ((4, 2), (10, 7)):
    single = [c] * 10                         # single-class batch
    spanning = [i % K for i in range(K * 3)]  # 3 samples per class, spans all classes
    acc_single = sum(1 for y in single if y == c) / len(single)
    acc_span = sum(1 for y in spanning if y == c) / len(spanning)
    expected_span = 1.0 / K
    print(f"C2 K={K} single-class-batch acc={acc_single * 100:.1f}PCT spanning-batch acc={acc_span * 100:.1f}PCT expected-chance={expected_span * 100:.1f}PCT")
    ok = ok and acc_single == 1.0 and abs(acc_span - expected_span) < 1e-12

# A single-class batch therefore cannot detect failure-to-learn: the constant
# predictor "passes" a 100%-accuracy criterion without any signal.
print("C2-SINGLE-CLASS-VOIDS-TEST: CONFIRMED")
print("C2-CLASS-SPANNING-REQUIRED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

expected.failureCriteria: constant predictor fails to win the single-class batch

cases.name: C4a healthy pipeline must PASS the protocol (pure-python MLP, FD-certified)
cases.objective: known-correct implementation (finite-difference gradient check) memorizes 12 class-spanning samples: 100% batch accuracy, loss far below ln(4) baseline
cases.command:
python3 - healthy 4 <<'PYEOF'
import math, random, sys

# C4 protocol core: pure-python MLP 6 -> dh(ReLU) -> 4, CE loss, SGD.
# Modes:
#   healthy  DH        - FD gradient check + 400 steps @ lr 0.5. Protocol must PASS.
#   shuffled 4         - misaligned labels, protocol escalation (1600 total, lr 1.0).
#                        Protocol must FAIL -> mechanical bug correctly flagged.
#   boundary 16        - EXCESS capacity at the SAME budget as healthy (400 @ 0.5):
#                        misaligned labels get fully memorized -> documents the
#                        capacity boundary of the protocol's inference.
def gen_data(seed=42, n=12, din=6, K=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    centers = [[rng.uniform(-1, 1) for _ in range(din)] for _ in range(K)]
    X, Y = [], []
    for i in range(n):
        c = i % K
        X.append([centers[c][j] + rng.gauss(0, 0.25) for j in range(din)])
        Y.append(c)
    return X, Y

def init_net(seed=7, din=6, dh=4, K=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    W1 = [[rng.gauss(0, math.sqrt(2.0 / din)) for _ in range(dh)] for _ in range(din)]
    b1 = [0.0] * dh
    W2 = [[rng.gauss(0, math.sqrt(2.0 / dh)) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(dh)]
    b2 = [0.0] * K
    return W1, b1, W2, b2

def forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    H, L = [], []
    for x in X:
        h = [max(0.0, sum(x[i] * W1[i][j] for i in range(len(x))) + b1[j]) for j in range(len(b1))]
        l = [sum(h[j] * W2[j][k] for j in range(len(h))) + b2[k] for k in range(len(b2))]
        H.append(h); L.append(l)
    return H, L

def softmax(l):
    m = max(l); e = [math.exp(v - m) for v in l]; s = sum(e)
    return [v / s for v in e]

def loss_acc(L, Y):
    tot = 0.0; hit = 0
    for l, y in zip(L, Y):
        p = softmax(l); tot += -math.log(p[y])
        if max(range(len(p)), key=lambda k: p[k]) == y: hit += 1
    return tot / len(Y), hit / len(Y)

def grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    H, L = forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)
    n, din, dh, K = len(Y), len(W1), len(b1), len(b2)
    P = [softmax(l) for l in L]
    dW1 = [[0.0] * dh for _ in range(din)]; db1 = [0.0] * dh
    dW2 = [[0.0] * K for _ in range(dh)]; db2 = [0.0] * K
    for s in range(n):
        dl = [P[s][k] - (1.0 if k == Y[s] else 0.0) for k in range(K)]
        for j in range(dh):
            for k in range(K): dW2[j][k] += H[s][j] * dl[k] / n
        for k in range(K): db2[k] += dl[k] / n
        for j in range(dh):
            if H[s][j] <= 0: continue
            g = sum(dl[k] * W2[j][k] for k in range(K))
            for i in range(din): dW1[i][j] += X[s][i] * g / n
            db1[j] += g / n
    return dW1, db1, dW2, db2

def sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, lr):
    for i in range(len(W1)):
        for j in range(len(W1[0])): W1[i][j] -= lr * dW1[i][j]
    for j in range(len(b1)): b1[j] -= lr * db1[j]
    for j in range(len(W2)):
        for k in range(len(W2[0])): W2[j][k] -= lr * dW2[j][k]
    for k in range(len(b2)): b2[k] -= lr * db2[k]

def train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, steps, lr):
    for _ in range(steps):
        dW1, db1, dW2, db2 = grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2)
        sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, lr)
    return loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)

lnK = math.log(4)
mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'healthy'
dh = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4
X, Y = gen_data()
if mode in ('shuffled', 'boundary'):
    s = random.Random(99)
    Y = Y[:]
    s.shuffle(Y)
W1, b1, W2, b2 = init_net(dh=dh)

if mode == 'healthy':
    # FD gradient check certifies the implementation is mechanically correct
    eps = 1e-6
    rng = random.Random(123)
    worst = 0.0
    for (mat, i, j) in [(W1, rng.randrange(6), rng.randrange(dh)) for _ in range(3)] + \
                        [(W2, rng.randrange(dh), rng.randrange(4)) for _ in range(2)]:
        orig = mat[i][j]
        mat[i][j] = orig + eps
        lp, _ = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
        mat[i][j] = orig - eps
        lm, _ = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
        mat[i][j] = orig
        num = (lp - lm) / (2 * eps)
        dW1, db1, dW2, db2 = grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2)
        ana = dW1[i][j] if mat is W1 else dW2[i][j]
        worst = max(worst, abs(num - ana) / max(abs(num), abs(ana), 1e-12))
    print(f"C4a FD-gradient-check max-rel-err={worst:.3e} (dh={dh})")
    if worst >= 1e-4:
        print("C4a-FAILED-FDCHECK"); sys.exit(1)
    loss0, acc0 = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
    lossf, accf = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    print(f"C4a step0 loss={loss0:.6f} (~ln4={lnK:.6f}) acc={acc0 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4a final loss={lossf:.6f} acc={accf * 100:.1f}PCT steps=400 lr=0.5 dh={dh}")
    passed = (accf == 1.0) and (lossf < 0.1 * lnK)
    print("C4a-PROTOCOL-PASS" if passed else "C4a-PROTOCOL-NOT-PASSED")
    print("C4a-HEALTHY-PIPELINE-VERIFIED" if passed else "C4a-FAILED")
    sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)

if mode == 'shuffled':
    print("C4b mechanical bug: labels shuffled independently of inputs (dh=4, task-matched)")
    loss1, acc1 = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    # protocol escalation: train LONGER (4x total) at RAISED lr (2x)
    loss2, acc2 = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 1200, 1.0)
    print(f"C4b phase1 (400 steps, lr 0.5): loss={loss1:.6f} acc={acc1 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4b phase2 (1600 total steps, lr 1.0): loss={loss2:.6f} acc={acc2 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4b chance floor ln(4)={lnK:.6f}; protocol pass bar: acc=100PCT and loss<0.1*lnK={0.1 * lnK:.6f}")
    protocol_fails = (acc2 < 1.0) or (loss2 > 0.1 * lnK)
    print("C4b-PROTOCOL-FAIL-DETECTED" if protocol_fails else "C4b-PROTOCOL-PASS-UNEXPECTED")
    print("C4b-MECHANICAL-BUG-CORRECTLY-FLAGGED" if protocol_fails else "C4b-DISCRIMINATION-BROKE")
    sys.exit(0 if protocol_fails else 1)

if mode == 'boundary':
    print("C4c excess capacity: SAME budget as healthy (400 steps, lr 0.5) but dh=16 on misaligned labels")
    lossf, accf = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    print(f"C4c final loss={lossf:.6f} acc={accf * 100:.1f}PCT steps=400 lr=0.5 dh=16")
    memorized = (accf == 1.0) and (lossf < 0.1)
    print("C4c-EXCESS-CAPACITY-MEMORIZES-SHUFFLED" if memorized else "C4c-EXCESS-CAPACITY-DID-NOT-MEMORIZE")
    print("C4c-CAPACITY-BOUNDARY-DOCUMENTED" if memorized else "C4c-OBSERVATION-DIFFERS")
    sys.exit(0 if memorized else 1)
PYEOF

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, FD rel-err < 1e-4, final acc 100%, loss < 0.1*ln(4)
expected.failureCriteria: FD check fails or healthy pipeline does not pass the protocol

    n, din, dh, K = len(Y), len(W1), len(b1), len(b2)
    P = [softmax(l) for l in L]
    dW1 = [[0.0] * dh for _ in range(din)]; db1 = [0.0] * dh
    dW2 = [[0.0] * K for _ in range(dh)]; db2 = [0.0] * K
    for s in range(n):
        dl = [P[s][k] - (1.0 if k == Y[s] else 0.0) for k in range(K)]
        for j in range(dh):
            for k in range(K): dW2[j][k] += H[s][j] * dl[k] / n
        for k in range(K): db2[k] += dl[k] / n
        for j in range(dh):
            if H[s][j] <= 0: continue
            g = sum(dl[k] * W2[j][k] for k in range(K))
            for i in range(din): dW1[i][j] += X[s][i] * g / n
            db1[j] += g / n
    return dW1, db1, dW2, db2

def sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, lr):
    for i in range(len(W1)):
        for j in range(len(W1[0])): W1[i][j] -= lr * dW1[i][j]
    for j in range(len(b1)): b1[j] -= lr * db1[j]
    for j in range(len(W2)):
        for k in range(len(W2[0])): W2[j][k] -= lr * dW2[j][k]
    for k in range(len(b2)): b2[k] -= lr * db2[k]

def train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, steps, lr):
    for _ in range(steps):
        dW1, db1, dW2, db2 = grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2)
        sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, lr)
    return loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)

lnK = math.log(4)
mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'healthy'
dh = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4
X, Y = gen_data()
if mode in ('shuffled', 'boundary'):
    s = random.Random(99)
    Y = Y[:]
    s.shuffle(Y)
W1, b1, W2, b2 = init_net(dh=dh)

if mode == 'healthy':
    # FD gradient check certifies the implementation is mechanically correct
    eps = 1e-6
    rng = random.Random(123)
    worst = 0.0
    for (mat, i, j) in [(W1, rng.randrange(6), rng.randrange(dh)) for _ in range(3)] + \
                        [(W2, rng.randrange(dh), rng.randrange(4)) for _ in range(2)]:
        orig = mat[i][j]
        mat[i][j] = orig + eps
        lp, _ = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
        mat[i][j] = orig - eps
        lm, _ = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
        mat[i][j] = orig
        num = (lp - lm) / (2 * eps)
        dW1, db1, dW2, db2 = grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2)
        ana = dW1[i][j] if mat is W1 else dW2[i][j]
        worst = max(worst, abs(num - ana) / max(abs(num), abs(ana), 1e-12))
    print(f"C4a FD-gradient-check max-rel-err={worst:.3e} (dh={dh})")
    if worst >= 1e-4:
        print("C4a-FAILED-FDCHECK"); sys.exit(1)
    loss0, acc0 = loss_acc(forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1], Y)
    lossf, accf = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    print(f"C4a step0 loss={loss0:.6f} (~ln4={lnK:.6f}) acc={acc0 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4a final loss={lossf:.6f} acc={accf * 100:.1f}PCT steps=400 lr=0.5 dh={dh}")
    passed = (accf == 1.0) and (lossf < 0.1 * lnK)
    print("C4a-PROTOCOL-PASS" if passed else "C4a-PROTOCOL-NOT-PASSED")
    print("C4a-HEALTHY-PIPELINE-VERIFIED" if passed else "C4a-FAILED")
    sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)

if mode == 'shuffled':
    print("C4b mechanical bug: labels shuffled independently of inputs (dh=4, task-matched)")
    loss1, acc1 = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    # protocol escalation: train LONGER (4x total) at RAISED lr (2x)
    loss2, acc2 = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 1200, 1.0)
    print(f"C4b phase1 (400 steps, lr 0.5): loss={loss1:.6f} acc={acc1 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4b phase2 (1600 total steps, lr 1.0): loss={loss2:.6f} acc={acc2 * 100:.1f}PCT")
    print(f"C4b chance floor ln(4)={lnK:.6f}; protocol pass bar: acc=100PCT and loss<0.1*lnK={0.1 * lnK:.6f}")
    protocol_fails = (acc2 < 1.0) or (loss2 > 0.1 * lnK)
    print("C4b-PROTOCOL-FAIL-DETECTED" if protocol_fails else "C4b-PROTOCOL-PASS-UNEXPECTED")
    print("C4b-MECHANICAL-BUG-CORRECTLY-FLAGGED" if protocol_fails else "C4b-DISCRIMINATION-BROKE")
    sys.exit(0 if protocol_fails else 1)

if mode == 'boundary':
    print("C4c excess capacity: SAME budget as healthy (400 steps, lr 0.5) but dh=16 on misaligned labels")
    lossf, accf = train(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2, 400, 0.5)
    print(f"C4c final loss={lossf:.6f} acc={accf * 100:.1f}PCT steps=400 lr=0.5 dh=16")
    memorized = (accf == 1.0) and (lossf < 0.1)
    print("C4c-EXCESS-CAPACITY-MEMORIZES-SHUFFLED" if memorized else "C4c-EXCESS-CAPACITY-DID-NOT-MEMORIZE")
    print("C4c-CAPACITY-BOUNDARY-DOCUMENTED" if memorized else "C4c-OBSERVATION-DIFFERS")
    sys.exit(0 if memorized else 1)
PYEOF

expected.failureCriteria: boundary behavior does not reproduce (result would still be reported honestly)

cases.name: C5 fixed loss threshold is scale-dependent (false-fails large-scale MSE)
cases.objective: identical regression problems at target scale 1 vs 1000, both fitted to the noise floor: fixed loss<1e-2 gives opposite verdicts; scale-relative criteria (R2) are consistent
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import math, random, sys

# Fixed absolute thresholds are invalid across target scales. Two identical
# regression problems differing ONLY in target scale (1x vs 1000x): the whole
# target (signal AND noise) is scaled. Both are fitted to their irreducible
# noise floor by exact least squares - i.e. both are "fully memorized" in the
# sense that no model can beat the noise floor.
rng = random.Random(2024)

def make_data(scale):
    xs, ys = [], []
    for i in range(40):
        x = rng.uniform(0, 1)
        y = (3.0 * x + rng.gauss(0, 0.01)) * scale
        xs.append(x); ys.append(y)
    return xs, ys

def fit_least_squares(xs, ys):
    n = len(xs)
    mx = sum(xs) / n; my = sum(ys) / n
    sxx = sum((x - mx) ** 2 for x in xs)
    sxy = sum((x - mx) * (y - my) for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
    w = sxy / sxx
    b = my - w * mx
    return w, b

def mse_and_r2(xs, ys, w, b):
    n = len(xs)
    mse = sum((y - (w * x + b)) ** 2 for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) / n
    var = sum((y - (sum(ys) / n)) ** 2 for y in ys) / n
    return mse, 1.0 - mse / var

results = {}
for name, scale in (("scale1", 1.0), ("scale1000", 1000.0)):
    xs, ys = make_data(scale)
    w, b = fit_least_squares(xs, ys)
    mse, r2 = mse_and_r2(xs, ys, w, b)
    results[name] = (mse, r2)
    fixed = "PASS" if mse < 1e-2 else "FAIL"
    print(f"C5 {name}: MSE={mse:.6f} R2={r2:.6f} fixed-threshold(loss<1e-2)={fixed}")

fixed_scale1 = results["scale1"][0] < 1e-2
fixed_scale1000 = results["scale1000"][0] < 1e-2
rel_ok = results["scale1"][1] > 0.99 and results["scale1000"][1] > 0.99

opposite = fixed_scale1 != fixed_scale1000
print(f"C5 fixed-threshold verdicts differ across scales: {opposite}")
print(f"C5 scale-relative (R2>0.99) verdicts consistent: {rel_ok}")
ok = opposite and rel_ok
print("C5-FIXED-THRESHOLD-SCALE-DEPENDENT" if opposite else "C5-FIXED-THRESHOLD-HELD")
print("C5-SCALE-RELATIVE-CRITERIA-REQUIRED" if ok else "C5-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, fixed threshold verdicts differ across scales while R2>0.99 both
expected.failureCriteria: fixed threshold holds across scales or relative criteria disagree

cases.name: C6 zero grads are normal: naive all-nonzero assertion is a false-positive generator
cases.objective: healthy memorizing pipeline with dead ReLU units carries exactly-zero grads; the naive assertion fails while the correct assertion (no NaN/Inf + per-layer nonzero) passes
cases.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import math, random, sys

# Zero gradients on individual parameters are NORMAL in a healthy pipeline
# (dead ReLU units); asserting all-non-zero grads is a false-positive machine.
def gen_data(seed=42, n=12, din=6, K=4):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    centers = [[rng.uniform(-1, 1) for _ in range(din)] for _ in range(K)]
    X, Y = [], []
    for i in range(n):
        c = i % K
        X.append([centers[c][j] + rng.gauss(0, 0.25) for j in range(din)])
        Y.append(c)
    return X, Y

def init_net(seed=7, din=6, dh=16, K=4):
    # dead_bias: half the hidden units start with a strongly negative bias and
    # never activate on this tiny batch -> exactly-zero grads, by construction
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    W1 = [[rng.gauss(0, math.sqrt(2.0 / din)) for _ in range(dh)] for _ in range(din)]
    b1 = [-3.0 if j >= dh // 2 else 0.0 for j in range(dh)]
    W2 = [[rng.gauss(0, math.sqrt(2.0 / dh)) for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(dh)]
    b2 = [0.0] * K
    return W1, b1, W2, b2

def forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    H, L = [], []
    for x in X:
        h = [max(0.0, sum(x[i] * W1[i][j] for i in range(len(x))) + b1[j]) for j in range(len(b1))]
        l = [sum(h[j] * W2[j][k] for j in range(len(h))) + b2[k] for k in range(len(b2))]
        H.append(h); L.append(l)
    return H, L

def softmax(l):
    m = max(l); e = [math.exp(v - m) for v in l]; s = sum(e)
    return [v / s for v in e]

def loss_acc(L, Y):
    tot = 0.0; hit = 0
    for l, y in zip(L, Y):
        p = softmax(l); tot += -math.log(p[y])
        if max(range(len(p)), key=lambda k: p[k]) == y: hit += 1
    return tot / len(Y), hit / len(Y)

def grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    H, L = forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)
    n, din, dh, K = len(Y), len(W1), len(b1), len(b2)
    P = [softmax(l) for l in L]
    dW1 = [[0.0] * dh for _ in range(din)]; db1 = [0.0] * dh
    dW2 = [[0.0] * K for _ in range(dh)]; db2 = [0.0] * K
    for s in range(n):
        dl = [P[s][k] - (1.0 if k == Y[s] else 0.0) for k in range(K)]
        for j in range(dh):
            for k in range(K): dW2[j][k] += H[s][j] * dl[k] / n
        for k in range(K): db2[k] += dl[k] / n
        for j in range(dh):
            if H[s][j] <= 0: continue
            g = sum(dl[k] * W2[j][k] for k in range(K))
            for i in range(din): dW1[i][j] += X[s][i] * g / n
            db1[j] += g / n
    return dW1, db1, dW2, db2

def sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, lr):
    for i in range(len(W1)):
        for j in range(len(W1[0])): W1[i][j] -= lr * dW1[i][j]
    for j in range(len(b1)): b1[j] -= lr * db1[j]
    for j in range(len(W2)):
        for k in range(len(W2[0])): W2[j][k] -= lr * dW2[j][k]
    for k in range(len(b2)): b2[k] -= lr * db2[k]

def count_zero(tensors):
    tot = 0; zero = 0
    for t in tensors:
        for row in t:
            for v in row:
                tot += 1
                if v == 0.0: zero += 1
    return tot, zero

X, Y = gen_data()
W1, b1, W2, b2 = init_net()  # half the hidden units are dead by construction

for step in range(600):
    dW1, db1, dW2, db2 = grads(X, Y, W1, b1, W2, b2)
    sgd(W1, b1, W2, b2, dW1, db1, dW2, db2, 0.5)

Lf = forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[1]
lossf, accf = loss_acc(Lf, Y)
tot, zero = count_zero((dW1, dW2))
nan_inf = any((v != v) or math.isinf(v) for t in (dW1, dW2) for row in t for v in row)
per_layer_nonzero = any(abs(v) > 0 for row in dW1 for v in row) and any(abs(v) > 0 for row in dW2 for v in row)

# dead-unit count actually observed in the forward pass
H = forward(X, W1, b1, W2, b2)[0]
dead_units = sum(1 for j in range(len(b1)) if all(h[j] == 0.0 for h in H))

print(f"C6 training with dead-biased init: final loss={lossf:.6f} acc={accf * 100:.1f}PCT")
print(f"C6 dead hidden units on this batch={dead_units} of {len(b1)}")
print(f"C6 zero-grad weights={zero} of {tot}")
naive_assertion_ok = (zero == 0) and not nan_inf
correct_assertion_ok = (not nan_inf) and per_layer_nonzero
print(f"C6 naive all-nonzero-grad assertion: {'PASS' if naive_assertion_ok else 'FAIL (false positive)'}")
print(f"C6 correct assertion (no NaN/Inf + every trainable layer has nonzero grad): {'PASS' if correct_assertion_ok else 'FAIL'}")

healthy = accf == 1.0
ok = healthy and zero > 0 and (not naive_assertion_ok) and correct_assertion_ok
print("C6-ZERO-GRADS-NORMAL-CONFIRMED" if ok else "C6-FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF

expected.successCriteria: exit 0, training reaches 100% acc with zero-grad weights present, naive assertion fails, correct assertion passes
expected.failureCriteria: no zero grads in a healthy pipeline or naive assertion passes

cases.name: C3 doc-based: PyTorch CrossEntropyLoss logits/dtype expectations (live fetch)
cases.objective: inspect the ACTUAL official PyTorch documentation from the user's machine: CE input must be unnormalized logits; target dtype long for class indices (record claims these are doc-verifiable per framework version)
cases.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# C3 (doc-based): inspect the ACTUAL PyTorch documentation for CrossEntropyLoss
# label-dtype and raw-logits expectations. Resolves the current stable version
# from the official redirect, fetches that exact versioned page, and asserts
# the documented statements. Executed on the user's machine through the bridge.
set -u
STABLE='https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss.html'
REDIR=$(curl -sL --max-time 25 "$STABLE") || { echo "C3-DOC-FETCH-FAILED: $STABLE"; exit 1; }
VER=$(printf '%s' "$REDIR" | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/generated' | head -1 | cut -d/ -f1)
if [ -z "$VER" ]; then echo "C3-DOC-VERSION-RESOLVE-FAILED"; exit 1; fi
URL="https://pytorch.org/docs/$VER/generated/torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss.html"
TMPF=$(mktemp)
curl -sL --max-time 30 "$URL" -o "$TMPF" || { echo "C3-DOC-FETCH-FAILED: $URL"; rm -f "$TMPF"; exit 1; }
python3 - "$TMPF" "$VER" "$URL" <<'PYEOF'
import sys, re, html
path, ver, url = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
raw = open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
text = html.unescape(re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', raw)))
checks = {
    'raw-logits-expected': 'unnormalized logits for each class',
    'target-dtype-long': 'The target data type is required to be',
    'class-indices-context': 'when using class indices',
}
print('DOC-SOURCE:', url)
print('DOC-VERSION:', ver)
ok = True
for name, needle in checks.items():
    found = needle in text
    print(f'DOC-{name}:', 'FOUND' if found else 'MISSING')
    ok = ok and found
m = re.search(r'The target data type[^.]*\.[^.]*\.?', text)
if m: print('DOC-QUOTE-dtype:', m.group(0)[:320])
m2 = re.search(r'[^.]{0,200}unnormalized logits for each class[^.]*\.', text)
if m2: print('DOC-QUOTE-logits:', m2.group(0)[:320])
m3 = re.search(r'[^.]{0,120}class probabilities only when[^.]*\.', text)
if m3: print('DOC-QUOTE-softlabel-nuance:', m3.group(0)[:320])
print('C3-DOC-VERIFIED' if ok else 'C3-DOC-NOT-VERIFIED')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PYEOF
rc=$?
rm -f "$TMPF"
exit $rc

expected.expectedResult: C3-DOC-VERIFIED with DOC-SOURCE, DOC-VERSION and quoted sentences
